articles.title: CME Group to Launch 100-Ounce Silver Futures to Meet Record Retail Demand
articles.mainIdea: CME Group to Launch 100-Ounce Silver Futures to Meet Record Retail Demand
articles.summary: PR Newswire: CME Group to Launch 100-Ounce Silver Futures to Meet Record Retail Demand. CME Group, the world's leading derivatives marketplace, today announced it will launch a 100-Ounce Silver futures contract on February 9, 2026, pending regulatory review. Related tickers mentioned: HOOD, SI=F.

articles.mainIdea: Core CPI Inflation Holds At Low 2.6%; S&P 500 Futures, Fed Rate-Cut Odds Rise (Live Coverage)
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Core CPI Inflation Holds At Low 2.6%; S&P 500 Futures, Fed Rate-Cut Odds Rise (Live Coverage). Core CPI inflation unexpectedly held at a low 2.6% in December. That's boosting S&P 500 futures and Federal Reserve rate-cut odds. Related tickers mentioned: ^GSPC.

articles.title: Annual inflation remains 2.7% in December, final 2025 report reveals
articles.mainIdea: Annual inflation remains 2.7% in December, final 2025 report reveals
articles.summary: USA TODAY: Annual inflation remains 2.7% in December, final 2025 report reveals. Economists see the report as a clearer window into U.S. inflation after data disruptions tied to the government shutdown impacted a prior release.
